decisions.statement: A room is a place inside the place it was a room of.
A room is as deep into the game as the place it is inside.
The light and the water in a place come off as conditions.
Every way out of a place comes off as one list.
The one an encounter sets in the way is a page of its own, named by it.
The gates an encounter reads a strike through come off its prose.

definition: the pages an old engine's places become, with what each place sets in the way
